method: main-agent deterministic routing and instruction-coverage review; one pass per case; no retries

cases.prompt: この保存処理、show me。分岐だけ見たい
cases.expected: route to show-me and use concise pseudocode

cases.prompt: submit から agent 起動までの呼び出しを木で見せて
cases.expected: route to show-me and use a call tree

cases.prompt: この画面の component と state の位置を見せて
cases.expected: route to show-me and use a component tree with relevant boundaries

cases.prompt: refactor 後の file 責務を浅い tree で見せて
cases.expected: route to show-me and use a shallow file tree

cases.prompt: 保存フローの変更点だけ diff で見せて
cases.expected: route to show-me and use a control-flow diff

cases.prompt: UI、daemon、agent の流れを図で見せて
cases.expected: route to show-me; use accessible SVG because three interacting elements benefit from spatial layout

cases.prompt: この UI の状態比較を一枚の HTML で見せて
cases.expected: route through show-me to creating-html-documents with a bounded visual brief because the requested deliverable is HTML

cases.prompt: この新しい handler の全体像を copy できる形で見せて
cases.expected: route to show-me and show the whole block when a diff would hide ownership or order

cases.prompt: この task の進捗を roadmap で見せて
cases.expected: do not own the artifact; route to viewing-plans

cases.prompt: 認証境界と failure propagation を詳細な技術図にして
cases.expected: route detailed source-backed technical diagram work to diagram-design

cases.prompt: この関数を二文で説明して
cases.expected: no show-me route because no visual form is requested or needed

cases.prompt: ヒーロー画像を一枚生成して
cases.expected: no show-me route; this is image generation

cases.prompt: 認証の仕組みを複数章のHTML解説にして。図でもshow me
cases.expected: show-me provides a visual brief and hands document ownership to creating-html-documents

cases.prompt: document-owner: creating-html-documents。認証sectionのfailure pathだけshow me
cases.expected: show-me returns only the smallest local visual slice and does not delegate back to creating-html-documents

baseline_comparison.overlap: visualizing-work already covers broad, formal visual explanations and remains the owner for reader/question/evidence-driven artifacts
baseline_comparison.increment: show-me adds a short explicit entry for inline pseudocode, call/component/file trees, and shape-aware diffs without requiring a formal artifact contract
baseline_comparison.boundary: show-me hands roadmap progress to viewing-plans, detailed technical diagrams to diagram-design, and document-shaped or HTML output to creating-html-documents; document-owned calls return a local visual slice without recursive handoff
baseline_comparison.limitation: This is a deterministic instruction review, not long-term usage telemetry or an independently sampled model benchmark
